messages.operation_guide_body:
HulenCut Operation Guide

[Import and navigation]
• Drag an image, folder, or .cutter project into the window, or use the Import menu.
• Ctrl+O: Import image; Ctrl+Shift+O: Import folder; Ctrl+P: Import project.
• Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right: Previous / next image.
• Enter an image number in the toolbar page box to jump directly.

[Selecting and moving slices]
• Left-drag on an empty area of the canvas to create a slice.
• Left-click a slice to select it; Ctrl/Shift click or drag to multi-select.
• Click an empty area to clear the current selection.
• Mouse button 4 (Back) selects the slice under the pointer.
• Hold mouse button 5 (Forward) and drag to move selected slices.
• Arrow keys move by 1px; Shift+Arrow keys move by 10px.

[Resizing slices]
• Eight resize handles appear when a slice is selected.
• Hover a handle and drag directly with the left button, mouse button 4, or mouse button 5 to resize. Double-clicking is not required.
• Handles hide automatically when the slice is deselected.

[Slice list]
• Each row shows the number, name, and X/Y/W/H values. Drag rows to reorder.
• Toolbar buttons move selected slices to the front, up, down, or to the end.
• Clear Names only clears names; Clear Slices deletes all slices on the current image.
• Right-click a slice to rename or delete it.

[Preview and search]
• The preview panel lets you edit the slice name, view the expected export name, and switch to the previous/next slice.
• Ctrl+K opens the command palette for searching and running common actions.
• Slice search supports the current image or the entire folder.

[Projects and export]
• Ctrl+S saves the .cutter project; Ctrl+Shift+S saves a copy.
• Ctrl+E exports slices as PNG/JPG/BMP.
• Set the default export folder and format under Export → Set Export Preset.

[Automation]
• Supports auto recognition, table detection, moving, scaling, filtering, merging overlapping slices, straightening, and page navigation.
• Record, import, and run .cscript scripts, including page-loop processing.
• Set the default export folder and format before running scripts that export slices.
• Creating slices, renaming, dividing slices, reordering slices, and cropping are not supported in automation.

[Appearance]
• Settings → Appearance switches between Dark, Light, and System themes.
• Settings → Language switches between Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English.
• Window → Reset Panel Layout restores the default layout.

[Notes]
• Save the project before cropping, straightening, or clearing slices.
• This version does not provide Undo/Redo.
• Watch the tutorial video for more examples.
